editorial: We don't have a full expense log for this trip.

Monteverde's main costs are the activities—guided wildlife walks, ziplining and transport—while local sodas make everyday meals easier on the wallet. San Jose did not give us enough time to form a useful budget view.

alternatives.title: What if we had a bigger budget?
editorial: We'd spend it on a better-located forest lodge and more guided nature experiences. In Costa Rica, a great naturalist can add more value than a fancier room.

alternatives.title: What if we had a smaller budget?
editorial: Choose one nature base and stay longer. Monteverde alone can fill several days without stacking expensive excursions back-to-back, and sodas keep meals reasonable.
